desc:
Welcome to LOCKED:2 a brand new, reworked version of LOCKED rebuilt from the ground up with enhanced gameplay mechanics, refined systems, improved performance, and a stronger competitive experience while preserving what made LOCKED unique.

Join our community server to stay up to date with news, updates, and exclusive reward codes!

Create dribble styles, dominate in your position, score every goal. Choose the impact you want to make in LOCKED:2, a Blue Lock inspired Roblox game.

PLAYER CONTROLS:

M1 - Dribble
M2 - Shoot
Q - Slide Tackle
R - First Weapon
T - Second Weapon
G - Flow
V - Charge Stamina
SHIFT - Run
CTRL - Shift-Lock

GK CONTROLS:

C - Dive Right
Z - Dive Left
F - Hand Block
Q - Front Dive
